theorem: mu_r is proportional to nu_r iff r in {1,2}; hence mu_r is nonproportional to native counting measure for every integer r>=3.

r1_r2.r1: The canonical cycle is the six D6 axis turns, so the source circle is partitioned into six equal 60-degree fibers.
r1_r2.r2: Each canonical sector has rays (2,0),(1,1),(0,2); source reflection about the sector bisector makes the two 30-degree fibers equal, and D6 transports this equality around the circle.

r3: The first two canonical symbol-2 turns have tan(Delta_0)/sqrt(3)=1/5 and tan(Delta_1)/sqrt(3)=3/13, hence unequal.
r4: The first two canonical symbol-2 turns have tan(Delta_0)/sqrt(3)=1/7 and tan(Delta_1)/sqrt(3)=1/6, hence unequal.

r_ge_5.AH_prefix: At the anchor rho_0=-4, so the first symbol is always 2. After it rho_1=3*r-13, which is positive for every r>=5, so the second symbol is always 1.
r_ge_5.equality_obstruction: Equality would give (r-1)(2*r-1)=2*r^2-r+3, equivalently r=-1, impossible for r>=5.
